senses.gloss:
Muṇḍibha Audanya or Audanyava is the name of a man in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa and the taittirīya brāhmaṇa.
Foot notes Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, xiii. 3, 5, 4. Apparently the word is a patronymic, ‘son of Udanya’ (so Eggeling, Sacred Books of the East, 44, 341, n. 1), or ‘son of Odana’ (so St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.).
taittirīya brāhmaṇa, iii. 9, 15, 3 (‘descendant of Udanyu’).
